systems.system: Public finance management software (approved software package for local government financial statements)
systems.owner: ANAFIC, under the World Bank's Support to Local Governance Project 2 (IDA-72740)
systems.tiers: local governments' public accountants; still being finalised at the mission of 5 to 13 May 2025, with the share of statements produced in it to be measured in December 2025; over 180 public accountants deployed and 356 local governments covered by training

note: A World Bank status report on the local governance project: accounting software for local governments still being finalised in May 2025, an application; nothing is stated about a connection at local government offices.
